The exact integral 6x7 Morse boundary has Smith factors 1,1,1,1,2 and one zero diagonal, with two independent kernel generators; π2 of a wedge of 2-spheres is its H2, so integral basis changes in degree vectors yield M(Z/2,2)∨S²∨2S³. Independent original complex boundary ranks over F2,F3,F5 agree. The finite exhaustive proof establishes the exact case but no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The 13-vertex Paley graph is a canonical finite vertex-transitive strongly regular graph. Its pure six-dimensional closed-neighborhood complex has a nontrivial Moore summand and both free H2 and H3, an exact torsion-sensitive homotopy classification not recoverable from Euler characteristic, rational data or strongly regular parameters. It gives a natural benchmark for intrinsic Čech topology and an obstruction to pure shellability.
